page.overview:
Who is Corinna A'Daasha?

Corinna A'Daasha was a female Human from the planet Corellia. After growing up in an opulent household, she left to explore the galaxy before settling down with her twin sister, Kandria A'Daasha, on the planet Adarlon. The twins founded and co-owned the Glow Dome nightclub there. After meeting a member of the No-Holds-Barred underground group, Corinna became a sympathizer to the Rebel Alliance—she never formally joined, but she offered aid and safety to Rebel agents at her nightclub.

Corinna A'Daasha, nicknamed Cori by her friends, and her twin sister Kandria A'Daasha were female Corellian Humans born on the planet Corellia into a wealthy family that provided for all their needs. As children, the sisters never struggled for anything, and although Kandria enjoyed a life of luxury, Corinna became bored and restless by it. Looking for excitement and adventure, Corinna ended up taking a portion of her wealth and leaving the A'Daasha household to explore the galaxy. Separation did not suit either sister, however, and shortly afterward Kandria joined Corinna on her travels. Kandria convinced Corinna to travel to the pleasure world Adarlon, where Corinna enjoyed her stay and the two sisters decided to try their hands at business.

The twins established the Glow Dome nightclub together. Featuring elaborate sound and light displays, it became extremely successful. Even though the twins were co-owners of the nightclub and each had at the venue an office of her own, Corinna took care of the day-to-day operations, such as handling security, for the purposes of which she bought a used seeker droid. Despite her success, Corinna still felt unfulfilled by her life until she met a member of the underground group No-Holds-Barred, who introduced her to banned holomaterials concerning the Rebel Alliance and the Jedi tradition of Force-users. Shortly after her introduction to the Rebellion's cause, Corinna became sympathetic to the organization, and although she never formally joined, she allowed underground holos to be sold at her nightclub and allowed Rebel operatives to use her business as a safehouse.

Corinna A'Daasha was the antithesis of her sister. Whereas Kandria enjoyed their luxurious lifestyle, Corinna's longing for excitement and adventure caused her to reject her opulent upbringing and made her sympathetic to the Rebellion. Corinna and her sister shared a love for clothes, although Kandria took more pride in her wardrobe collection and put more care into it: Corinna, on the other hand, despite enjoying pieces that she felt accentuated her features, would often wear the same clothing.
